```python
PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (11e-6, 6e-6, 16e-6),     # gain-stage current
    "If":    (8.5e-6, 4e-6, 12e-6),    # follower current (sets output pole gm_f/CL)
    "gmid1": (20, 12, 24),             # M1 gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),         # M1 length
    "gmidf": (15, 8, 20),              # follower gm/Id
    "gmidp": (10, 6, 14),              # PMOS load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),          # PMOS load L
    "Rf":    (430e3, 400e3, 520e3),    # feedback resistor
    "Cf":    (3e-15, 0.2e-15, 20e-15), # feedback cap (damping)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    I1, If, Rf, Cf = p["I1"], p["If"], p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    Ipb = 1.5e-6
    gmid_b, Lb = 12.0, 1.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.2)
    vout = m1.vgs
    mf = lut.size("n", p["gmidf"], 0.3, If, vds=VDD - vout, vsb=vout)
    vx = vout + mf.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=VDD - vx)

    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Iref, vds=0.6)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Iref, vds=mref.vgs)
    msk  = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, If, vds=vout)
    mnb  = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Ipb, vds=0.8)
    mpb  = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=m2.vgs)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MSK", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", msk)
    n.dev("MNB", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("MF", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", mf)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    A0 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m2.gds)
    Af = mf.gm / (mf.gm + mf.gmbs + mf.gds + msk.gds)
    T = A0 * Af
    zt = Rf * T / (1 + T)
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg + Cf
    Cx = m1.cdd + m2.cdd + mf.cgd + 2e-15
    Rx = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m2.gds)
    wi = 1.0 / (Rf * Cin); wa = 1.0 / (Rx * Cx)
    wn = math.sqrt((1 + T) * wi * wa)
    wo = mf.gm / (cl + 0.2 * mf.cgg)
    f3db = wn / (2 * PI) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(1 + (wn / wo) ** 2)) * 1.15
    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    vn2 = kT4 * (2.0 / 3.0) * (m1.gm + m2.gm) / m1.gm ** 2
    w1m = 2 * PI * 1e6
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + vn2 * (w1m * (Cin)) ** 2
    power = VDD * (Iref + Ipb + I1 + If)
    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(zt), "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout, "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2)}
```
